messages.text: Cilantro allergy. Not really an allergy — that genetic thing where it tastes like soap. But effectively I avoid it entirely.
The OR6A2 gene situation — well documented and means roughly 14% of the population perceives cilantro as soap. I'll treat it as a hard avoid the same as a true allergy.
Need a green sauce for grilled meat. Most chimichurri recipes have cilantro alongside parsley.

## Parsley-Only Chimichurri

Classic Argentine chimichurri actually uses parsley as the star anyway — cilantro is a modern addition.

In a bowl, combine:
- 1 cup finely chopped flat-leaf parsley
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- ½ tsp red pepper flakes
- 2 tbsp red wine vinegar
- ½ cup olive oil
- 1 tsp salt

Let sit 30 minutes for flavors to meld. Spoon over grilled steak, chicken, or roasted vegetables.
Glad cilantro isn't actually traditional. Vindication.
